what: checkOverlap() : coverage gap between b- and y-ions
title: Validate PSMs based on spectral and identification features
text: check evaluates whether matched b-ions y-ions together cover entire peptide sequence. Given peptide length nn, highest matched b-ion index bmaxb_max highest matched y-ion index ymaxy_max, gap exists : n−ymax>bmaxn - y_max > b_max checkOverlap() returns FALSE gap detected TRUE b- y-ions jointly cover sequence overlap. Interpretation gap. gap indicates region peptide covered matched fragment. often points unaccounted-modification sitting uncovered stretch. Consider sequence sp_psms[115]$sequence: identified sequence contain modification yet checkOverlap() returns FALSE, applying modification one residues identified gap restore fragment coverage. PSM object from a data.frame  ## ---------------------------- ## Case 1: Duplicate identifications  psmdf <- data.frame(psm = paste0("psm", 1:10),                     peptide = paste0("pep", c(1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 8)),                     protein = paste0("Prot", LETTERS[c(1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 3, 5, 6, 6)])) psmdf #>      psm peptide protein #> 1   psm1    pep1   ProtA #> 2   psm2    pep1   ProtA #> 3   psm3    pep2   ProtB #> 4   psm4    pep2   ProtB #> 5   psm5    pep3   ProtC #> 6   psm6    pep4   ProtD #> 7   psm7    pep6   ProtC #> 8   psm8    pep7   ProtE #> 9   psm9    pep8   ProtF #> 10 psm10    pep8   ProtF psm <- PSM(psmdf, peptide = "peptide", protein = "protein") psm #> PSM with 10 rows and 3 columns. #> names(3): psm peptide protein makeAdjacencyMatrix(psm) #> 7 x 6 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix" #>      ProtA ProtB ProtC ProtD ProtE ProtF #> pep1     2     .     .     .     .     . #> pep2     .     2     .     .     .     . #> pep3     .     .     1     .     .     . #> pep4     .     .     .     1     .     . #> pep6     .     .     1     .     .     . #> pep7     .     .     .     .     1     . #> pep8     .     .     .     .     .     2  ## title: Validate a PSM — validatePSM
text: Validate PSM checking spectral features. Calling validatePSM() applies different checks mentioned . Failing check guarantee bad identification per se, provide information assess confidence dubious PSMs confirm already good identifications. checks can called individually . can applied MS2 spectra, need MS1 MS2 spectra. Use Spectra::filterMsLevel() accordingly.

title: Validate a PSM — validatePSM
code: validatePSM(x, peptideVariable = "peptide", fdr = "fdr", ...)  checkABpresence(x, fragments = NULL)  checkXYpresence(x, fragments = NULL)  checkOverlap(   x,   peptideVariable = "peptide",   fragments = NULL,   strippedSeq = NULL )  checkShiftConsistency(   x,   peptideVariable = "peptide",   fragments = NULL,   strippedSeq = NULL )  checkParentIonIntensity(x, peaks = NULL, tolerance = 0, ppm = 20)  checkPrecursorPurity(   x,   tolerance = 0.05,   ppm = 0,   useReportedIsolationWindow = FALSE,   BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam() )

title: Validate a PSM — validatePSM
text: x Spectra object containing MS1 MS2 spectra run(s). MS1 spectra used source isolation window peak data; MS2 paired nearest preceding MS1 scan (sorted retention time within dataOrigin). peptideVariable character length 1L, representing peptide sequence identification. fdr character length 1L, representing FDR value identification. ... Arguments passed checkParentIonIntensity() fragments result labelFragments() x. strippedSeq canonical sequences. length peptideVariable. peaks spectrum peak data (result Spectra::peaksData()). tolerance Numeric(1) Absolute m/z half-width (Da) isolation window used useReportedIsolationWindow = FALSE (default 0.05). ppm Numeric(1) Additional m/z-proportional tolerance (ppm) added tolerance defining isolation window (default 0). useReportedIsolationWindow logical(1) TRUE, use isolationWindowLowerMz / isolationWindowUpperMz metadata stored spectra rather computing window tolerance ppm. Defaults FALSE. BPPARAM BiocParallelParam instance controlling parallel evaluation (one job per unique dataOrigin). Defaults BiocParallel::SerialParam().

title: Validate a PSM — validatePSM
text: data.frame() checks different validation metrics. checkABpresence() : TRUE a2-b2 fragments present. checkXYpresence() : TRUE x2-y2 fragments present. checkOverlap() : Detects gap coverage b- y-ions. Returns FALSE gap found (b- y-ions jointly cover full sequence), may indicate unsearched modification. Returns TRUE b- y-ions overlap, confirming identification. checkShiftConsistency() : case modifications present: returns percentage potential mass shifts actually matched. applicable modifications: NA. checkParentIonIntensity() : relative intensity parent ion base peak. value close 1 indicates poor fragmentation. checkPrecursorPurity() returns numeric vector length length(x). value ratio -intense peak total intensity within isolation window corresponding MS1 scan, computed Spectra::precursorPurity(). MS1 spectra MS2 spectra preceding MS1 scan return NA.
